title: Publish convergence workflow anchors
summary: Publish Studio-side convergence workflow anchors for the accepted Top 10 Control/Studio queue, including connection center, app switcher, proposal inbox v2, patch artifact viewer, sandbox apply, edit boundary, safe edit planning, shell merge, native/web parity, and repo orchestration.
